messages:
maria: Heads-up — CI on main is red; deploy-test job failing with secret error. logs:

```
Error: vault: failed to fetch secret: lease has expired
at /workspace/.cache/vault-agent/token.go:42
Caused by: failed to renew token: 403 Forbidden
```

maria: It started around commit a1b2c3d.. anyone able to rerun and bisect?

ci-bot: Workflow run 4321 for branch main failed on job deploy-test (exit 1). Failed at step `fetch-secrets`

ashok: I can rerun now. quick check — are we seeing vault-agent tokens not renewing after CI runner spin-up? might be the approle TTL change.

jen: Also seeing KMS decrypt errors in a different job earlier:

```
aws-kms: Decrypt failed: AccessDeniedException
Resource: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456:key/abcd-ef01
```

jen: Could be that the ephemeral role attached to runners lost kms:Decrypt permission after the role update yesterday.

patrick: Rerun requested and started: gh actions rerun workflow 4321

patrick: Ran a quick bisect: the job passes on commit a1b2c3d2 (good) and fails on a1b2c3d6 (bad). That narrows to commits between a1b2c3d3..a1b2c3d6

maria: Nice — @ashok can you check vault role TTL and the github runner assume-role workflow? maybe the short lease is colliding with long job queue time.

ashok: On it. Initial look: approle token TTL default 1h, but we rotate the role-id/secret-id every 30m via the onboard script. If runner delays >30m token becomes invalid. quick patch: extend secret_id TTL to 2h and add proactive renew in runner setup.

opsbot: NOTE: temporary mitigation applied — increased secret_id ttl for ci-role to 120m (expires in 118m). Audit: changelog #987

jen: After opsbot change, I triggered a rerun on the failing build.

ci-bot: Rerun 4321.2 started — waiting for job to reach fetch-secrets

maria: While that runs, can someone open a short PR to make runner setup call `vault login -method=approle -retry=5` and schedule background renew? minimal script in infra repo.

ashok: Will open PR. Also adding a check to fail early if token TTL < 20m at job start.

patrick: Rerun came back green on that commit. Seems mitigation helped. Re-run on the previously failing bad commit also passed.

maria: Great. Follow-ups: (1) PR to infra to add renewer + TTL check, (2) audit KMS role permissions for the ephemeral role (jen?), (3) add monitoring alert for vault token renewal failures.

jen: I'll take KMS audit today.

maria: Thanks all — marking this thread resolved unless anything else pops up. :thumbsup:
